Cross straps and central front medallion align with shoulder straps; the rear crossing straps, two hip pouches, belt and riveted skirt remain physically coherent. Native front/rear crops expose attachment paths.
Paired knee discs remain front-facing with visible fastening bands around the rear. Boots, lower legs and grounded soles are complete in both profiles and cardinal faces.

source_interpretation_limit: The Atlas supplies one small front oblique appearance. Hidden reverse details are consistent authored interpretation; the body sheet does not establish native topology, rigging or animation.
